decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The building shall not be used any time other than for office use. The building shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling.

Condition : 5 - 11.2	The application for the erection of first floor rear extension and roof dormer and alterations to ground floor of existing office building, as shown on drawing numbers 630.P.02, 630.P.04, 630.P.05, 630.P.06, and 630.P.07 received 4 October 2005 and 630.P.03 Revision A received 23 November 2005, is recommended for approval as the proposed development would not harm the appearance of the existing building or unduly reduce the existing amenity of neighbouring properties. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development and ENV-E.1.2 Locations for Business (B1) Use.
description: Erection of first floor rear extension on first floor to create room and alterations to front and rear on the ground floor of existing office
